next_step_summary: PR #249 extends the populated provider-independent Question Engine inventory with the recurring pre-signing termination + cure + notice mechanism. The bounded slice keeps breach triggers, expressly fundamental/material breach categories, notice/cure mechanics, contract cancellation, contractual vacancy demands, and cross-clause interactions separate. Immediate-vacancy or self-help wording is preserved only as contract text and is not converted into a physical-eviction procedure claim. It adds no eviction-procedure runtime, statutory/case-law runtime, court-outcome logic, post-dispute mode, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, workflows, or network access. The next bounded inventory slice is option / renewal mechanics; after the CORE inventory sequence is complete, the product owner requested a periodic Codex batch audit before the next implementation layer.
